data.name: Katyusha
data.detailed_description:
Katyusha is a 2D Platform/RPG with pixel art graphics, devoted to the popular character named in the original Soviet song, written by Mikhail Isakovsky and composed by Matvei Blanter in 1938.

A character that has never been seen introduced before in a movie or video game, Katyusha was Soviet Union's most popular song in World War II as it was encouraging soldiers between battles, even though it was released before WWII. The song describes a young girl named Katyusha, who exchanges letters with her boyfriend who is fighting in the front.

In 1941 Germany invades Soviet Union. Katyusha lives near the borders. Her boyfriend advises her to leave and save her life. Katyusha leaves but her feelings won't let her abandon her boyfriend. She wants to find him. So she decides to join the Soviet army. That would be her only hope of finding him back one day.

Katyusha is being developed around 4 pillars:

Immersion

- An immersive World War II story based on real-life battles and real WWII facts.
- Meet real Soviet heroes, learn their stories and fight on their side.
- See your comrades either live or die in the battle. The game is based on real events.
- Fight bosses with real WWII equipment.

Innovation

- Economy system: Buy and Sell your items to NPCs with real WWII prices.
- Crafting system: Create your armor, weapons and gear, using materials that you will find or scrap.
- Levelling system with freedom of choices to develop Katyusha.
- Unique stealth kill system based on players' skill.
- Pet companion that levels up like Katyusha and can be used in battle.
- Random loot drops from enemies.
- Multiple endings

Entertainment

- Take the Soviet heroes with you as NPC companions and fight on their side.
- Intense battles with Advanced A.I.
- Quests based on real-life events
- In-game economy which includes trades and crafting

Emotions

- Learn all the backstory of famous Soviet World War II personalities which will be your NPC companions
- Find your beloved boyfriend
- Read real-life letters from both Soviet and German soldiers
- World War II atmosphere: Experience the victory and also the death in your eyes.

Summary

Katyusha is a fast-paced 2D pixel art Platform/RPG which contains lots of emotional moments. Take control of Katyusha as she has to survive in Soviet Union during World War II. The combat system includes melee combos and ranged weapons, among with stealth kills. Real World War II weapons will be used for this purpose.

A levelling system allows you to gain xp, level up and train Katyusha to learn new skills. Katyusha's skills include healing, movement skills and weapon skills. Checkpoints are symbolised by mailboxes as Katyusha sends letters to save her progress.

Katyusha can also use her grey steppe eagle to attack her enemies. Her relationship with the eagle depends on her actions. You can choose to feed your eagle or order him to attack. A bar under the health meter will show your relationship with the eagle, which will affect his response in battle. Also, the eagle can gain xp, level up and unlock new skills.

Both Katyusha and eagle can level up and unlock new skills to attack their enemies. Katyusha will also use vehicles (including the 3 famous Katyusha trucks which were used during the war) and meet famous iconic people from World War 2, which either lived or died during the war. They will train her to reach her ultimate goal. Survive the war and meet her beloved.

Many of Katyusha's skills will be revealed in the future.

Historical battles and personalities

Meet Soviet Union's heroes. From Lyudmila Pavlichenko to Vasily Zaitsev, legends that turned the side of the war will fight with your side as NPC companions, by both giving you quests and assisting you in battle. The NPC companions will be available in the battles that they actually took part, as either soldiers or training officers. They will also survive or die in the exact battles that they were killed. This will be your ultimate experience of learning their backstory through dialogues.

Crafting & Economy system
Katyusha is trying to bring realism to a deeper level. Every enemy drops random loot. The game has also an Economy system based on real WWII prices (in rubles). Katyusha can buy and sell items to NPCs, but she can also choose to scrap items for materials, so that she can craft her armor, weapons and gear. Crafting has a different levelling system and allows you to create items with better stats and higher durability. 

Real-life letters

When Katyusha's comrades are killed they drop letters. Katyusha will also find letters from German soldiers. All those letters are real-life experiences that soldiers wrote in paper and sent to their families during World War II. We also accept letters from any of you kept from your relatives. You send them via email and those will be posted, either with the original poster, or using alternate names. Photo of letters are required to prove the identification.

Soundtrack

Katyusha's soundtrack has already been released. It has revised versions of classic WWII songs, re-created especially for the purpose of the game. Please buy the soundtrack, to support Katyusha's development.

Development

Loresoft is a small indie development team which consists of 6 developers from various countries. We have plans of Kickstarter, release in consoles, as well as thinking about the possibility of making the game available via early access. All these points will be discussed in the future. Right now we work as an individual team without a publisher.

Katyusha is going to be released for PC (Windows/Linux) and Mac, as well as the most common platforms. Stay tuned for new updates, screenshots and videos.

data.short_description: A 2D Platform/RPG with Pixel Art graphics. Live World War II through the eyes of Katyusha, as she is looking her boyfriend who has left for the war. Experience the stories of famous Soviet heroes, real battles, level up, gather loot, craft items and fight enemies in the biggest historical battles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processador: Intel Dual Core i7-5500U
  • Memória: 2 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Nvidia GeForce 920M or any GPU of at least 1GB
  • DirectX: Versão 9.0
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 190 MB de espaço livre
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processador: Any Intel Quad Core CPU
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: Nvidia or any GPU of at least 2GB
  • DirectX: Versão 9.0
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 190 MB de espaço livre
